// @autogenerated
Uid* (string)::
Unique identifier of the invitation.
Tenant* (xref:#entidad-tenant[Tenant])::
Tenant the invitation is for.
Email* (string)::
Email the invitation is sent to.
Roles (string)::
Roles granted to the user when the invitation is accepted.
Invited by* (xref:#entidad-user[User])::
User who sent the invitation.
Token hash* (string)::
Digest of the invitation token sent by email; the raw value is never stored.
Metadata json (blob)::
Additional data of the invitation, as JSON.
Status (UserInvitationStatusOptions)::
State of the invitation: pending, accepted, cancelled or expired.Los posibles valores que toma el campo son:
 * pending
 * accepted
 * cancelled
 * expired

Created at* (datetime)::
When the invitation was sent.
Expires at* (datetime)::
When the invitation expires if it is not accepted.
Accepted at (datetime)::
When the invitation was accepted.
Accepted by (xref:#entidad-user[User])::
User who accepted the invitation.
Version (integer)::
Campo con el número de version de user invitation para controlar bloqueos optimistas
